title: Subsampled first pass: fill every number for Jev, Laya and Kev
description:
Collect a pre-declared, nested subsample of every cell in the frozen coverage (500 items per cell; controls and small cells in full) for all three models, so the leaderboard has a number everywhere. A later epic grows the sample; nested means it only adds items.

Each **run** below is one discrete, resumable job that writes answer files, so any run can be done on another Mac and returned by committing to a branch.

## Rules
- The subsample order is fixed in advance (seeded hash of the item id), never chosen by answers. Originals and twins stay together. Identical for every model.
- One GPU job at a time per machine. Never run two runs at once.
- Jev is an online service: its runs wait for the user's explicit go.
- Results are reported as partial, with the sample size shown.
